content:
When throwing two standard six-sided dice, each die has faces numbered from 1 to 6. The possible sums of the two dice range from 2 (1+1) to 12 (6+6).

Since 13 is outside this range of possible sums, the probability of getting a sum of 13 when throwing two dice is **0**.
